lines_of_business: State Products: MediSource; MediSource Connect; Child Health Plus; Essential Plan
effective_or_revised: Effective 6/1/2013; version control last row 4/1/2026 Reviewed
criteria_location: Policy, p.2: a not-covered list (3 items) and a short covered-indicator list (4 items). Outerbridge definition p.2-3. About one page of actual criteria.

logic.top_level: other (exclusion list plus exception list; no all-of criteria for approval)
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: The policy is mostly an exclusion list: lavage alone; debridement for OA with knee pain only; lavage with or without debridement in severe OA (Outerbridge III-IV).

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Unless there are specific indicators in addition to pain, Independent Health will not cover arthroscopic debridement and lavage of the knee in the context of OA alone. Specific indicators ... Loose bodies; Unstable flaps of articular cartilage; Disruption of the meniscus; Impinging osteophytes.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Any one indicator suffices? But the third excluded item (severe OA, grade III-IV) is stated without an exception; unclear whether an indicator overrides severe OA.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Arthroscopic lavage with or without debridement in members presenting with severe osteoarthritis
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Overlaps with the indicators list: a meniscal disruption in grade III OA is both excluded and a covered indicator.

requirement_kinds.quote: Arthroscopic debridement for osteoarthritis in members presenting with knee pain only
severe osteoarthritis as defined in the Outerbridge classification scale, grades III and IV
Loose bodies; Unstable flaps of articular cartilage; Disruption of the meniscus; Impinging osteophytes
Pre-authorization is not required at the present time. Criteria above will be utilized upon retro-review.

thresholds.quote: Grades III and IV are characteristic of severe osteoarthritis
Grade II is defined as fragmentation or fissuring in an area <1 cm

external_dependencies.what: New York State Medicaid criteria and Medicaid Update bulletins (2012)
external_dependencies.quote: Per New York State criteria, knee arthroscopy using debridement and lavage as a treatment for osteoarthritis is not covered.
payment for covered services is subject to eligibility criteria, contract exclusions and the limitations noted in the member's contract

definitions_that_change_meaning.definition_quote: NOTE: Grades III and IV are characteristic of severe osteoarthritis

vague_terms.quote: specific indicators in addition to pain
vague_terms.problem: Undefined; list is of findings, not of required documentation.
No tear type, no imaging requirement, no conservative therapy.
There is no prior-auth gate; criteria apply only at retrospective review.

extraction_hazards: Checkbox glyphs (☐ ☒) carry the line-of-business meaning
Outerbridge definition list split across a page break
interesting_structures: Not-covered-first structure; approval is by exception indicators
Grade definitions differ from other payers (grade II <1 cm vs <1.5 cm)

fit_to_tree.why: Tiny, but it is a NOT tree with an exception list, and the severe-OA exclusion versus indicator override is not resolved in the text.
